card.name: Linking words before diet or dose conditions
card.fires_on: Small linking tokens (on, with, a comma, a space before a number) just before a condition or time limit. Typical settings are patients on a sodium-restricted diet, lists of potassium supplements, and within 30 minutes or 1 hour.

modes.label: Patients on a diet
modes.description: The word on or with after patients, leading into a diet or a condition.
modes.example: Take sodium content into consideration in patients<< on>> a sodium-restricted diet.

modes.label: Comma in potassium lists
modes.description: A comma after potassium supplements in lists of interacting agents.
modes.example: Concomitant use of FILSPARI with potassium-sparing diuretics, potassium supplements<<,>> potassium-containing salt substitutes, or other drugs

modes.label: Space before a time or number
modes.description: The space just before a number in a time window or a threshold.
modes.example: Instruct patients to take repaglinide tablets within<< >>30 minutes before meals.

card.plain: It marks small joining words and spaces that come right before a diet, potassium or timing detail.
